test_numba_vs_python_noop: test the numba engine produces identical results to the python engine for identity apply on a DataFrame
test_numba_vs_python_reductions: test the numba engine produces identical results to the python engine for mean, min, max, and sum reductions
test_numba_parallel_unsupported: test that parallel apply with numba engine raises NotImplementedError when raw=False
test_numba_nonunique_unsupported: test that apply with numba engine raises NotImplementedError when index or columns are non-unique
test_numba_unsupported_dtypes: test that apply with numba engine raises ValueError for object dtype and pyarrow extension array columns
